shape: things you only understand after a certain age or a certain life change

slides.text: what you only realize about your older sibling years later
they had to do everything first, with no one to show them how.
[[they took the loudest yells]] so the hallway would be quiet by the time you got there.
they let you win the fights over the front seat and the remote.
they were [[just a kid themselves]], even when they felt like an adult to you.
they kept your secrets from the kitchen table without ever asking for a favor.
they fought all the strict rules so your curfew could be later.
send this to [[the one who went first]]

caption:
i didn't see it when we were sharing a hallway,
but i see it now.
thank you for going first.
send this to your older sibling.

#siblings #family #growingup #oldersibling
